pairs: Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Præcipe filiis Israël,
Instruct the sons of Israel,
ut afferant tibi oleum de olivis purissimum, ac lucidum,
so that they may bring to you clear oil from the purest olives,
ad concinnandas lucernas jugiter,
in order to supply the lamps continuously
extra velum testimonii in tabernaculo fœderis.
outside the veil of the testimony in the tabernacle of the covenant.
Ponetque eas Aaron a vespere usque ad mane coram Domino,
And Aaron shall place these, from evening until morning, before the Lord,
cultu rituque perpetuo in generationibus vestris.
as a perpetual worship and ritual in your generations.
Super candelabrum mundissimum ponentur semper in conspectu Domini.
They shall be placed upon the most pure candlestick in the sight of the Lord always.
Accipies quoque similam,
You shall also receive fine wheat flour,
et coques ex ea duodecim panes,
and you shall bake twelve loaves from it,
qui singuli habebunt duas decimas:
each loaf of which shall have two-tenths.
quorum senos altrinsecus super mensam purissimam coram Domino statues:
And you shall arrange them, six on each side, upon the most pure table before the Lord.
et pones super eos thus lucidissimum,
And you shall place upon them the clearest frankincense,
ut sit panis in monimentum oblationis Domini.
so that the bread may be a memorial of oblation for the Lord.
Per singula sabbata mutabuntur coram Domino suscepti a filiis Israël fœdere sempiterno:
On each Sabbath, they shall be changed before the Lord, having been received from the sons of Israel as an everlasting covenant.
eruntque Aaron
And they shall be for Aaron and his sons,
et filiorum ejus,
so that they may eat these in the holy place;
ut comedant eos in loco sancto:
for it is the Holy of holies from the sacrifices of the Lord,
quia Sanctum sanctorum est de sacrificiis Domini jure perpetuo.
as a perpetual right.
Ecce autem egressus filius mulieris Israëlitidis,
Then, behold, the son of an Israelite woman,
quem pepererat de viro ægyptio inter filios Israël,
whom she had born of an Egyptian man among the sons of Israel, going out,
jurgatus est in castris cum viro Israëlita.
was quarreling in the camp with a man of Israel.
Cumque blasphemasset nomen,
And when he had blasphemed the name,
et maledixisset ei,
and had cursed it,
adductus est ad Moysen.
he was led to Moses.
(Vocabatur autem mater ejus Salumith,
(Now his mother was called Shelomith,
filia Dabri de tribu Dan.)
the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan.)
Miseruntque eum in carcerem,
And they sent him to prison,
donec nossent quid juberet Dominus.
until they might know what the Lord would command,
Qui locutus est ad Moysen,
who spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Educ blasphemum extra castra,
Lead away the blasphemer beyond the camp,
et ponant omnes qui audierunt, manus suas super caput ejus,
and let all who heard him place their hands upon his head,
et lapidet eum populus universus.
and let the entire people stone him.
Et ad filios Israël loqueris: Homo,
And you shall say to the sons of Israel:
qui maledixerit Deo suo, portabit peccatum suum;
The man who curses his God shall bear his sin,
et qui blasphemaverit nomen Domini, morte moriatur:
and whoever will have blasphemed the name of the Lord shall be put to death.
lapidibus opprimet eum omnis multitudo,
The entire multitude shall overwhelm him with stones,
sive ille civis, sive peregrinus fuerit.
whether he be a citizen or a sojourner.
Qui blasphemaverit nomen Domini, morte moriatur.
Whoever blasphemes the name of the Lord shall be put to death.
Qui percusserit, et occiderit hominem, morte moriatur.
Whoever will have struck and killed a man shall be put to death.
Qui percusserit animal, reddet vicarium, id est,
Whoever will have struck down an animal shall repay its equivalent,
animam pro anima.
that is, a life for a life.
Qui irrogaverit maculam cuilibet civium suorum,
Whoever will have inflicted a blemish on any of his citizens,
sicut fecit,
just as he has done,
sic fiet ei:
so shall it be done to him:
fracturam pro fractura,
fracture for fracture, eye for eye,
oculum pro oculo,
tooth for tooth,
dentem pro dente restituet: qualem inflixerit maculam,
shall he repay. Whatever degree of blemish he has inflicted,
talem sustinere cogetur.
so shall he be compelled to suffer.
Qui percusserit jumentum,
Whoever strikes down a beast,
reddet aliud.
shall repay another.
Qui percusserit hominem, punietur.
Whoever strikes a man shall be punished.
Æquum judicium sit inter vos,
Let there be equal judgment among you,
sive peregrinus,
whether it is a sojourner
sive civis peccaverit:
or a citizen who will have sinned.
quia ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
For I am the Lord your God.
Locutusque est Moyses ad filios Israël:
And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel.
et eduxerunt eum, qui blasphemaverat,
And they led away him who had blasphemed,
extra castra,
beyond the camp,
ac lapidibus oppresserunt.
and they overwhelmed him with stones.
Feceruntque filii Israël sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
And the sons of Israel did just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
